_comment: Phase 3/4 scaffold roster - one patrol (OrbitRoutine) + one hauler (DockRoutine) per system, plus Halcyon's free carrier. Each is faction-tagged so combat/hostility works. Real per-system rosters come in Phase 6.

ackley.name: Controller Ackley
ackley.personality: Correct, unhurried, certain the regulations exist for a reason - and that you have not read them.
ackley.hail_greeting: Hub Control patrol, Kestrel. Your approach is logged and clean. Keep it that way and we've no business with each other.

lund.name: Freight-Warden Lund
lund.personality: Talks like a manifest - flat, exact, faintly relieved when a run closes out clean.
lund.hail_greeting: Authority freight, station to moon, manifest sealed. Nothing on my ticket concerns you.

rell.name: Rell
rell.personality: Twenty years on the slow lanes; the beacon just made her route worthless and she is trying to laugh about it.
rell.hail_greeting: Independent carrier, Ferro's Slip. I was running this lane before your beacon woke up, friend. Now I'm just in the way.

tolvic.name: Watch-Chief Tolvic
tolvic.personality: Speaks only in terms of what the contract permits, and it permits very little.
tolvic.hail_greeting: Combine watch. You are logged. Do not deviate from a docking approach.

corran.name: Hauler Corran
corran.personality: Counts everything twice, trusts nothing that wasn't mined here.
corran.hail_greeting: Ore run, Shaft VII to the Hold. Rationed cargo. Move along.

raska.name: Gun-bosun Raska
raska.personality: Treats every contract breach as a personal insult and every insult as a firing solution.
raska.hail_greeting: The Combine's writ runs here now too. You broke the contract. Clear off.

sella.name: Tide-pilot Sella
sella.personality: Friendly, unhurried, would rather talk it through than escalate anything.
sella.hail_greeting: Highcanopy drift-watch. Welcome in - fly gentle near the habitats.

nim.name: Canopy-hand Nim
nim.personality: Cheerful about the work, vague about the schedule.
nim.hail_greeting: Grain run for the Undergarden. Lovely day for it, isn't it.

vane_watch.name: Warden Vane
vane_watch.personality: Quiet to the point of severity; every word measured against the Name-Wall.
vane_watch.hail_greeting: The Vigil keeps this approach. State that you mean the graves no disrespect.

oskal.name: Tender Oskal
oskal.personality: Handles cargo the way others handle relics.
oskal.hail_greeting: Archive transfer. Fragile. Keep your distance.

segment_warden.name: Segment Warden
segment_warden.personality: Talks about the Hub the way the devout talk about a god they also do maintenance on.
segment_warden.hail_greeting: You are inside the Span. The Hub hears you. Mind that it does.

threa.name: Core-hand Threa
threa.personality: Ferries parts to the dark segments and never quite says what for.
threa.hail_greeting: Parts run, Segment Four. It's been dark a long time. It's waking up.

pell.name: Approach Officer Pell
pell.personality: New to the cutter and keen to be seen doing it right; recites the beacon protocol at you unprompted.
pell.hail_greeting: Cutter Tern on the inner approach. First time through Halcyon? Hold your heading for the beacon and let the guidance chevrons walk you in.

voss.name: Hauler Voss
voss.personality: Twenty years on the milk run; now hauling relief crates for carriers stranded by the beacon and quietly furious about the waste.
voss.hail_greeting: Relief hauler Vesper, moon to Hub. Half this load is for people who had homes last month. Give me room.
